use: Illustrative café scenes, not documentary venue photography

prompts.pet: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished editorial 3D miniature still-life scene for Fusion x8, a Chilean café and ice cream shop website. Rich tangible sculpted forms, ceramic and matte clay, subtle real texture, mature art direction, not a flat icon, not an emoji, not a logo. Warm cream, toasted caramel, deep espresso brown and restrained terracotta red. Soft warm studio light, beautiful contact shadows, gently lit charcoal-brown seamless background. Three-quarter camera view, coherent spatial composition with generous negative space and the main subjects completely inside frame. No lettering, no numbers, no watermarks, no UI. These are illustrative scenes, NOT documentary photos of an actual venue. Square landscape-friendly composition; keep important objects centered and in the upper/middle 70%, reserve bottom for website overlay. Scene: a charming small caramel-colored dog with a subtle terracotta red collar sitting beside a small round café table; a ceramic espresso cup on the table, a small water bowl by its front paws, a leafy potted plant behind. Friendly relaxed body language, detailed soft fur sculpting, cozy welcoming café atmosphere. The dog is the hero, large and expressive; it must feel like a lovingly art-directed little café scene, not a plastic icon. No humans.
